title: Long-Standing Member Protected Points Reserve — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Reserve schedule.** At a Service Accounts and Repair Orders month-end points expiry run, a protected reserve of aged points follows how long the account has been open and its tier.

| Whole months from the account's opening date to the day the run is made | Account tier | Aged points protected |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum | 500 |
| 60 or more | Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 250 |
| Fewer than 60, or any other tier | — | none |

A whole month is complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day.

**Edges (hypothetical dates).** Account opened 31 August: the 60th whole month completes on 31 August five years later. A run made 30 August of that year counts 59 whole months; a run made 31 August counts 60.
